Read all original TSV columns as strings; preserve IDs and leading zeros. Trim outer whitespace only in IDs and timestamp fields. Preserve prose and classification labels.
Avoid ID precision loss and unintended changes to text.
Remove only fully identical source rows across Notes files. Exclude all remaining records with conflicting repeated noteId; never select an arbitrary winner.
Repeated tweetId across different notes is a valid one-to-many relationship.
Interpret -1 in eligibility fields as not eligible. Keep missing optional fields. Invalid/missing IDs and invalid timestamps cannot enter the analysis cohort.
Missing eligibility does not mean eligible; missing prose does not invalidate a key.
Use noteRequestFeedEligibleAtMillis only. Include unique eligible posts on or before the fixed UTC cutoff. A note counts only when eligibility <= creation <= cutoff.
Match the Phase 1 coverage definition; notes before eligibility do not count.
Aggregate qualifying notes to one row per tweetId before joining. Keep every eligible request, including unmatched ones.
Prevent multiple notes from multiplying the coverage denominator.
Unmatched means no qualifying note observed in supplied files, not proof of no note on X. Preserve suspicious values in raw sources and report exclusions.
File completeness and snapshot alignment are not established by a successful join.
